instructions.text: Set a cast-iron pan over medium heat. Mix the mayo and spices into a bowl. Add the chicken and slather the marinade on the exterior.
Add the chicken to the pan and brown on each side, about 3-4 minutes per side. Cook until the internal temp is 160. Slice and enjoy.
Drizzle oil into a pan over medium-low heat. Add diced jalapeno and cumin seeds and cook until just fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the pintos and cook, while stirring for another 4-5 minutes.
Spread a thin layer of sour cream on the bottom which will act as a glue for the beans and provide even coverage of the sour cream instead of getting large gloops everywhere.

For rolling purposes, I find it best to position the fillings in the upper third. First, hit it with a layer of the seasoned beans. Now here is where I like to add hot sauce as an acidic layer. Follow this with a generous helping of the chicken then a sprinkle of queso fresco, the diced tomatoes minced cilantro, some shredded lettuce, and you better not forget the pickled onions. Check the video for how to roll!
